title: "Photos"

Drop your images into an `images/` folder and reference them below. Quarto's
`layout-ncol` lays them out in an even grid automatically.

::: {layout-ncol="3"}
![Caption one](images/placeholder1.jpg)

![Caption two](images/placeholder2.jpg)

![Caption three](images/placeholder3.jpg)
:::

*Tip: for a lightbox (click-to-enlarge) effect, add the `quarto-lightbox`
extension later with `quarto add quarto-ext/lightbox`.*
